cloud-drive-downloader v0.7.1

- Unified download solution for multiple cloud drives, supporting Baidu, Aliyun, Quark, Tianyi, 115, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, and many more.
- No need to install individual official clients; uses a unified CLI integrating AList, rclone, BaiduPCS-Go, Quark CLI, WebDAV, aria2, and curl.
- Credential management is handled securely via system credential stores; passwords and tokens are never stored or displayed in plain text.
- Supports local (Windows, macOS, Linux) and remote storage (NAS/SSH/WebDAV/SMB/S3/rclone).
- Added PWA shell and web status page (`/test`), Chrome extension for quick link sending, clipboard monitoring, and enhanced Web UI for task management.
- Strict security rules: does not bypass platform restrictions, handles only user-provided credentials safely, and preserves data boundaries.
